description: TXN-FLUSH-BEHIND, locating the end of the write-behind window inside (250, 500] ms (the first card had one file timeline). On the big fixture opened shared read/write, an implicit INSERT INTO T (S, M) SELECT S, M FROM T (dbFailOnError; Errors before/after, RecordsAffected) is followed by the main file's size and hash (P.Files) right after the return and every 40 ms for 640 ms, each look bracketed by a Signal mark carrying the time. The sequence is run three times in the same probe (the table doubles each time). Asks the time at which the file image changes and whether it repeats.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
